spcmp.error: Message of the card that compares two MS2 spectra when the spectrum or the comparison fails; {message} = the engine's text.
spcmp.mirror.desc: Spoken description of the mirror plot in the MS2 comparison card; {a} = number of ions of spectrum A drawn above, {b} = number of ions of spectrum B drawn below, {n} = number of matched ions joined by lines.
spcmp.mirror.key.matched: Key at the top right of the mirror plot in the MS2 comparison card; {n} = number of matched ions.
spcmp.off.apex: Evidence of an automatic m/z offset in the comparison card; {rt} = retention time in minutes of the apex of the known ion.
spcmp.off.auto: Line of the offsets list of the MS2 comparison card for a side whose offset was measured on a known ion; {side} = A or B, {da} = the offset in Da, {mz} = m/z of the ion, {status} = found, found but wide, or not found, {detail} = the evidence (apex time, spread, scans, signal).
spcmp.off.autoNear: As the automatic-offset line when a time was given; {side} = A or B, {da} = the offset in Da, {mz} = m/z of the ion, {rt} = the time in minutes it was looked for near, {status} = found, found but wide, or not found, {detail} = the evidence.
spcmp.off.scans: Evidence of an automatic m/z offset in the comparison card; {n} = number of scans the offset was measured on.
spcmp.off.snr: Evidence of an automatic m/z offset in the comparison card; {snr} = apex signal as a multiple of the median of the ion's trace.
spcmp.off.spread: Evidence of an automatic m/z offset in the comparison card; {da} = spread of the ion's m/z across its scans in Da.
spcmp.off.used: Line of the offsets list of the MS2 comparison card for a side with a fixed offset; {side} = A or B, {da} = the offset in Da.
spcmp.off.warned: An offset line of the MS2 comparison card followed by the engine's warning about it; {line} = the line, {warn} = the warning text.
spcmp.summary: Line under the cosine of the card that compares two MS2 spectra; {n} = number of matched bins, {tol} = tolerance between bin centres in Da, {ce} = collision energy tolerance in eV.
